pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, dark brown polygonal patches with jagged, stellate margins. Patch edges exhibit sharp pixel gradients against the lighter interstices. Spatial area of patches decreases significantly from the dorsal midline towards the lower flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A complex network of light-colored, buff interstices forming a continuous topological lattice. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial, with corridor thickness narrowing to approximately 5-10 pixels in high-density patch regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck displays a consistent, low-amplitude serration. The 1D contour shows high-frequency, small-scale protrusions against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian organism, likely an oxpecker, perched on the dorsal ridge at the transition between the upper shoulder and neck.
